newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Dec 11.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following business stories in its Wednesday edition.

WASHINGTON - Federal prosecutors in Germany have handed up a criminal indictment against Jose Ignacio Lopez, the former General Motors Corp. executive who defected to Volkswagen AG along with three of his associates, on multiple charges of misappropriating GM documents.

WASHINGTON - The computer industry and its attorneys watch for litigation boom after a New York jury awarded $6 million in damages to three women who said they were injured by using their computer keyboards.
WASHINGTON - MCI Communications Corp. is giving up its 800-MUSIC-NOW service, just one year after launching the venture to sell compact discs over phone lines.
WASHINGTON - After discussing a $1 million sponsorship of the Public Broadcasting Service children's show "Wishbone," snack food giant Frito-Lay Co. says it is no longer interested. ---
WASHINGTON - Black & Decker Corp. stock was reeling after the company announced it would have lower-than-expected earnings for the fourth quarter and the entire year.
